svg.aria-label: Mora AI. AI-driven CI/CD root-cause analysis. A pipeline fails, the AI falls back from Bedrock to Ollama to a local model, finds the cause, and a one-click fix ships it to EKS.

g.text: Finds CI/CD pipeline failures and writes the
